review:
Aztec Magic Bonanza combines BGaming's Aztec theme with pay-anywhere refilling reels on a 6x5 grid. Matching symbols anywhere on screen pay, and winning symbols are cleared so new ones can refill the board.

Multiplier symbols only appear during free spins. Each one takes a random value from 2x to 100x and stays on screen until the refill sequence ends, when all visible multipliers are added together and applied to that sequence's win. Chance x2 increases the bet to make four scatters more likely, and a bonus buy is available in permitted markets. BGaming rates it high volatility with a 10,200x maximum. The RTP is 96.11%, and free spins trigger roughly once every 398 spins, so expect long waits for the bonus.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 398 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
